tintinnācŭlus , a, um, adj. id.,
I.tinkling, clinking, clanking: “educi ad tintinnaculos,” i. e. to the manacled malefactors, Plaut. Truc. 4, 3, 8 Spengel ad loc. (acc. to others, the executioners who fastened the chains).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
